title: DeliaTurnPresentation (proposal v2)
description: PROPOSED — not activated in runtime. Contract target for DELIA conversational presentation, extending presentation v1 (compose_presentation) with a per-block format discriminator for safe conversational Markdown (CP-333). Producer: delia-api application/interaction. Consumer: DELIA MFE via plugin-ui renderer. Unknown versions MUST NOT validate against this schema and MUST fail closed to the legacy/plain path defined in doc 84.

version.description: Closed discriminator. v1 payloads (version '1' or absent version member) and any other value are handled by the legacy/plain contract — never coerced into v2 semantics.

message_kind.description: Canonical producer-declared kind; drives allowed_interactions. Never derived from prose by the consumer.

semantic_status.description: EpistemicClass verbatim from the governed result; null when the producer declared none. External specialist output is always OBSERVATION at the source.

grounding_status.description: Provenance marker — never truth elevation (GROUNDED != FACT).

blocks.description: Ordered display blocks. Closed allowlist of kinds — providers/models can never introduce new kinds.

allowed_interactions.description: Existing confirmation vocabulary only. Authorizes nothing; cannot widen execution authority.

format.description: REQUIRED discriminator. 'plain' renders verbatim inert text. 'markdown_safe' is admitted for the allowlisted token renderer — absent or unknown values fail closed to inert plain text.

text.description: Bounded block content. For 'markdown_safe' this is the raw markdown source admitted from governed inputs only (typed structured data or declared producer output) — never arbitrary model/provider prose.

role.description: Bounded verbatim owner vocabulary (e.g. declared precondition). URL-free by construction — never a link, credential, or raw payload.
